name: Effective Range / Projected Positive No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
details: Every coordinate trace has effective range at most that of the original class, and positive no-clashing teaching dimension is at most effective range.
proof: Apply $\mathrm{NCTD}^{+}(\mathcal H_{|S})\leq\mathrm E(\mathcal H_{|S})\leq\mathrm E(\mathcal H)$ to every S and maximize.
